verdict.rationale: Crossmint agent cards are order intents. Each gives the agent a fixed allowance with an amount and an expiration, enforced through Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay. The merchant is locked for the intent's lifetime, credentials are one-time, and the agent never sees the real card number. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs; broader card eligibility (Visa use is limited to eligible U.S. cards and excludes business, prepaid, Chase and Fidelity cards); and the encrypted-card fallback returns the real saved card to the key holder when no network rail is usable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand my agent a scoped, limited-use payment credential — amount limits, expiry, merchant restrictions — instead of a raw card number
